question: If an object is moving with an actual speed of x in uniform motion, find the average speed of the object.
solution:
The correct answer is the __**x.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In uniform motion, a **speed of a body remains constant **at any instant in time.
 
• Therefore, we can say the** body covers an equal distance** in an equal interval of time.
 
• In uniform motion, **since the velocity does not change, **the acceleration of the body remains constant.
 
• Now, the **average speed is the ratio of the total distance **covered by the body to the total time taken by the body to cover this distance.
 
• In a non-uniform motion, the speed of the body **changes at any instant in time.**
